name: Ethereal Waltz
source:
Long ago, Selina's father made enemies with the wrong person, who then had their city ripped from their world into one fraught with dangers.

Now, her days are filled not with ballrooms and splendor, but with the gritty reality of protecting their people from the magical spirits within this realm. Whatever drives them, the end result is disastrous for those involved.

As Selina dreams of a normal life, one of those spirits starts to take notice of her...

[From [url=https://circlepegasi.itch.io/ethereal-waltz]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，塞莉娜的父亲得罪了一个惹不起的人。对方将他们的城市从原本的世界中剥离，送往危机四伏的异界。

如今，充斥她日常的已不再是舞厅与华彩，而是保护子民、对抗这个领域中的魔法灵体的残酷现实。无论这些灵体受什么驱使，最终都会给牵涉其中的人带来灾难。

就在塞莉娜梦想着过上普通生活时，其中一个灵体开始注意到她…

[摘自[url=https://circlepegasi.itch.io/ethereal-waltz]itch.io[/url]]
